items.title: Clyde Kerr Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, Rome, New York, August 22, 2006
items.q: [(boilerplate)] Clyde was interviewed in Rome, New York on August 22, 2006 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

ctx.x: Clyde was interviewed in Rome, New York on August 22, 2006 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming in Rome, New York for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. It’s a pleasure for me to have Clyde Kerr Jr. with me today.
